cards.text: Friend, pull up a stool. The king of Aram is at war against Israel. After talking it over with his servants, he says, "My camp will be in such and such a place."
But Elisha, the man of God, sends a message to the king of Israel about that exact spot.

cards.question: Elisha sends the king of Israel a message about the spot where Aram plans to camp. What does the message say?

answers.text: Be careful not to pass by that place
Set up your own camp there first
Attack that place before they arrive

cards.question: The king of Israel ignores the warning Elisha sends him about the place where the Arameans are going.

cards.text: Time and again, Aram picks a spot and Israel's king is already on guard there. That's like planning a surprise party for a guy who's IN the group chat.

cards.question: The king of Aram's plans keep getting blocked, and he's enraged. Who does he think is behind it?

answers.text: Scouts from Israel on the hills

cards.text: One of the servants answers, "No one, my lord the king." The leak is Elisha, the prophet in Israel.

cards.question: The servant says Elisha tells the king of Israel the very words the king of Aram speaks in his ___.

cards.text: His BEDROOM! Now the king of Aram wants Elisha found, so he can send men to capture him.

cards.question: The report comes back to the king of Aram. Where is Elisha?
To capture Elisha, the king of Aram sends horses, chariots and a great ___.

cards.text: The army goes by night and surrounds the city, all for ONE prophet. That's calling the fire department to blow out a birthday candle.
Early in the morning, Elisha's servant goes outside and sees an army with horses and chariots all around the city.

cards.question: When Elisha's servant sees the army around the city, he asks Elisha what they are going to do.
Elisha tells his servant not to be afraid. What reason does he give?

answers.text: There are more with us than with them
The army will leave before night
The city walls are too strong for them

cards.text: I bet that servant feels VERY outnumbered right now. Then Elisha prays, "O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see."

cards.question: The LORD opens the young man's eyes, and he sees the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around ___.

cards.text: Now the Arameans come down against Elisha. And Elisha prays again.

cards.question: As the Arameans come down against him, what does Elisha ask the LORD to do to them?

answers.text: Put them into a deep sleep

cards.text: So the LORD strikes them with blindness, according to the word of Elisha.

cards.question: Elisha tells the blinded Arameans, "This is not the way, and this is not the city."

cards.text: Then Elisha says, "Follow me, and I will take you to the man you are seeking." That's the guy you're looking for offering to help you look for him!

cards.question: Elisha leads the blinded Arameans to the city of ___.

cards.text: They walk all the way into Samaria. Then Elisha prays one more time.

cards.question: Inside Samaria, Elisha asks the LORD to open the ___ of the Arameans.

cards.text: The Arameans look around and discover they're in Samaria. That's dozing off on the train and waking up at the VERY last stop.
The king of Israel sees them and turns to Elisha, calling him "My father…"

cards.question: With the Arameans standing in Samaria, what does the king of Israel ask Elisha?

answers.text: Whether he should keep them as servants
Whether he should send them back blind

cards.text: The king asks it TWICE: "…shall I kill them? Shall I kill them?"

cards.question: Elisha tells the king of Israel to go ahead and kill the Arameans.

cards.text: Then Elisha asks the king, "Would you kill those you have captured with your own sword or bow?"

cards.question: Elisha tells the king of Israel not to kill the Arameans. What does Elisha tell the king to do with them?

answers.text: Set food and water before them
Lock them up in the city prison
Make them work on the city walls

cards.question: The king of Israel doesn't hold back. He prepares a great ___ for the Arameans.

cards.text: The Arameans showed up to capture a prophet, and they leave with a FEAST in them. When they finish eating and drinking, the king sends them away, and they go back to their master.

cards.question: After the king of Israel feeds the Arameans and sends them home, the Aramean raiders do not come into the land of Israel again.
